name: The Bottom Shard

date.label: The Burning Crusade · quest sequence; exact date unknown

summary: One shard is held by Pathaleon the Calculator in the Mechanar. The destination is one of Tempest Keep’s floating wings, a machine-world of precise metal and crystal. The quest asks for the Bottom Shard as one part of a pair; it does not say that Pathaleon alone controls the prison. The search remains divided across two dungeons, and the first fragment is only useful when reunited with its counterpart.
